title: O. Madden

Sceptre’s jockey according to Sports.

Herbert Otto Madden, normally known as “Otto” (02 January 1873 in Hoppegarten – 21 May 1942 in Newmarket, Suffolk) was a four time British flat racing Champion Jockey
